options.name: --file
options.description: Set file path.

options.name: --libraries
options.description:
Set one or more dependency (libs) directories, e.g.
-l "C:\a" "C:\b" (space-separated).

options.name: --output
options.description: Set output path.

options.name: --protections
options.description:
Set protections list, also can be set via
protections.json.

options.name: --protections-file
options.description: Set protections configuration file path.

options.name: --criticals-file
options.description: Set criticals configuration file path.

options.name: --logging-file
options.description: Set logging configuration file path.

options.name: --obfuscation-file
options.description: Set obfuscation configuration file path.

options.name: --plugins
options.description:
Custom plugins directory to load custom protections
from (overrides PluginsDirectoryName in
obfuscation.json). Relative paths resolve against
BitMono's base directory.

options.name: --no-watermark
options.description:
Disable watermarking (overrides obfuscation.json
setting).

options.name: --nologo
options.description:
Don't display the BitMono logo (ASCII banner) on
startup. Mirrors the dotnet/MSBuild --nologo
convention.

options.name: --strong-name-key
options.description:
Path to strong name key (.snk) file for assembly
signing.

options.name: --output-name
options.description: Set output file name.

options.name: --preset
options.description:
Protection preset/level: Custom, Minimal, Balanced,
or Maximum. When not Custom it overrides
protections.json (an explicit -p/--protections list
still wins; CLI --preset wins over
obfuscation.json).

options.name: --il2cpp
options.description:
Build the assembly for a Unity IL2CPP game: skip
protections that aren't IL2CPP-compatible (native
code, calli, PE packers, etc.) so the il2cpp.exe
build doesn't break. Set automatically by the
BitMono Unity integration.

options.name: --inspect-metadata
options.description:
Parse a Unity IL2CPP global-metadata.dat and print
its version + the names/literals it exposes, then
exit. Standalone diagnostic; doesn't obfuscate.

options.name: --encrypt-metadata
options.description:
Encrypt a Unity IL2CPP global-metadata.dat (writes
<path>.enc) so static dumpers can't parse it.
Requires the matching native decryptor in
GameAssembly.dll.

options.name: --metadata-key
options.description:
16-byte key as 32 hex chars for --encrypt-metadata
/ --rename-il2cpp-exports. Must match the key
compiled into the native decryptor. Omit to use the
fixed dev key; the Unity integration passes a
random per-build key.

options.name: --rename-il2cpp-exports
options.description:
Mangle the il2cpp_* exports of a native
GameAssembly.dll so dumpers can't find the IL2CPP
API by name. Use --metadata-key to match the key
compiled into the decryptor; the game resolves them
at runtime.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
